correctness.rationale: This is the final assessment of /workspace/repairs/3/RESULT.md. The frozen Finding did not specify the direction of an ordered pair, and normalization was asserted for every n even when there are no pairs. These are corrected explicitly: scan decreasing summand indices for the displayed PGF, transpose it for increasing indices, and pool only when the total is positive (certainly for n≥p+q+2, witnessed by B_{n−p−q−2} followed by 1). Order matters: at (p,q)=(1,2), [uv²] is zero in the decreasing-index PGF, whereas [u²v] is ab(1−z)/(1+b)>0. Rechecked the full repaired argument: the first dropped unit and the next nonzero digit determine each full block uniquely; the terminal suffix is a proper coefficient prefix. C(z)=1 has a simple root and no same-modulus competitor because the block lengths contain consecutive integers. For one marked block or two marked consecutive blocks the generating function is T·W/(1−C)^2, with W the block weight or consecutive product. The total word count is Θ(z^−n) and the full block count Θ(n z^−n), so boundary errors vanish in the ratio, and marked-count ratios tend to W(z). A bulk block contributes one external-to-next-first pair, plus one internal-to-external pair for type B; evaluating at u=v=1 gives the normalization 1+b. The two marginals coincide, and after subtracting p from both gaps the mean is (h_0−bd)/(1+b) and the product moment is (h_0−bd)(1−b)h_0/(1+b), giving exactly the factored covariance. The golden-root identity and independently checked residual signs at the two rational brackets establish the three witnesses; covariance is invariant under transposition.
residual_risks: Fixed p,q pointwise convergence under pooled weighting. No uniform parameter rate, full sign classification or independence at zero covariance. The archived finite enumeration is corroboration only.

value.rationale: Successive-gap statistics measure a natural local dependence that single-gap laws leave open. The explicit two-variable expression is uniform across fixed p,q, including the less tractable spacing range of the single-gap transfer-matrix predecessor, and gives exact zero, positive and negative lag-one examples in the same q=1 family. The repaired order convention is justified by orientation-dependent joint probabilities; it leaves the scientific content unchanged.
